title: docs.sentry.io/pricing
snippet:
Sentry offers a 14 day free trial with unlimited event data on the Business plan. You can upgrade or return to the features and quotas included with your existing plan. Without a paid plan, you will be automatically assigned a free Developer plan at the end of your trial.
Every paid plan includes a [preset volume](https://docs.sentry.io/pricing.md#pricing-how-it-works) of event data, with a PAYG bugdet that you control. The free Developer plan has similar presets. See Sentry's [plan page](https://sentry.io/pricing/) for more details.

## [Plans and Free Trials](https://docs.sentry.io/pricing.md#plans-and-free-trials)
Sentry has one free Developer plan and three paid plans: Team, Business, and Enterprise. You can find more information about each by going to our [pricing page](https://sentry.io/pricing/).
Plan upgrades take effect immediately. Plan downgrades and cancellations are processed at the end of the current contract cycle and cannot be refunded. If you no longer want to be on a paid plan, you'll revert to the base Developer plan at the end of your current contract.
All new Sentry accounts come with a 14-day free trial period. You'll have the option to upgrade and continue to use Sentry's paid features at any time before your trial ends. Upgrades will be effective immediately. Users who haven't upgraded by the end of their free trial will return to the features and quotas included with their existing plan.

Next rung up

### Developer
$0 a month
one user, 5,000 errors, 30 day lookback
Error monitoring and tracing, email alerts, 10 dashboards and MCP access. The plan adds no API and no third party integrations, and no pay as you go budget is documented for it.
### Team
$26 a month
annual billing, 29 USD on the monthly cycle
50,000 errors, 5 GB of logs, 5 M spans, 50 replays, unlimited users, 20 dashboards and up to 90 days of lookback.

Sentry sells a plan per organization, not per seat on the paid tiers. **Developer is 0 USD for one user, Team is 26 USD billed annually or 29 USD billed monthly, and Business is 80 or 89 USD**. Enterprise carries no published figure.
Sentry plan fees in USD, read from sentry.io/pricing and its structured data on 5 November 2026.
| Plan | Annual, a month | Monthly, a month | Users | Dashboards | Lookback |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Developer | 0 USD | 0 USD | 1 | 10 | 30 days |
| Team | 26 USD | 29 USD | Unlimited | 20 | Up to 90 days |
| Business | 80 USD | 89 USD | Unlimited | Unlimited | Up to 90 days |
| Enterprise | Quoted | Quoted | Unlimited | Unlimited | Custom |
Annual billing is prepaid: the structured data prints 312 USD a year for Team and 960 USD for Business, which divide back to 26 and 80. The monthly cycle is a subscription at 29 and 89 USD.

One developer with one small project stays on Developer at 0 USD. **The step to Team is bought for unlimited users, the API and ten times the error quota**, and that only pays off once a second person or a real error volume arrives, because the free plan bills nothing and drops nothing.

| Free error allowance | 5,000 errors | 100,000 exceptions | No error tracking |
| What the meter counts | Errors, spans, replays, gigabytes, monitors | Exceptions, gigabytes, monitors, responders | Monitors and seats |
